- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.10) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 2–5% for next 5–10 days.  
- After sharp price spikes (≥ 5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at 10–15% above recent high for 3–7 days.  
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.10) and price is falling, model underestimates; add 3–7% to forecast for next 5–10 days.  
- Model shows strong mean reversion bias: if price is above 30-day moving average, forecast should be adjusted downward by 1–3% per day until convergence.  
- For 30-day horizon, model often overpredicts early in the forecast window; apply 1–3% downward correction for days 1–7.  
- If sentiment history shows alternating positive/negative swings, model tends to lag; add 1–2% to forecast for days 8–15 to catch momentum.
